card.name: Just before obesity or weight terms
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or punctuation right before an expected obesity or weight-gain term, such as a percentage before 'obesity rate' or a list of metabolic changes before 'body weight gain'.

modes.label: Before obesity rates
modes.description: A space or number just before a statistic about adult obesity.
modes.example: with a nearly<< >>35-percent adult obesity rate.

modes.label: Metabolic change lists
modes.description: A comma, 'and' or 'include' in a list of metabolic effects that ends in weight gain.
modes.example: These metabolic changes include hyperglycemia, dyslipidemia<<,>> and body weight gain.

modes.label: Before overweight
modes.description: A linking word right before 'overweight' in a risk description.
modes.example: Women of childbearing age who<< are>> overweight or have a history of IH are

card.writes: It raises obesity, overweight, BMI and weight words as the next likely word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to mention obesity or weight gain.
